name: Bellwarden
title: Keeper of the Hollow Chime
biography: A bronze bell hangs over this lesser reaper’s skeletal binding. It drifts through the chapel’s lower halls, gathering echoes for Vesper.
weakness: Its binding is exposed after the heavy scythe or bell ring settles.

skills.name: Bell Reap
skills.description: The broad silver scythe sweeps a locked sector. Move behind the keeper.

skills.name: Hollow Chime
skills.description: A ringing annulus spreads from the bell. Stay in the clear center or outside its edge.

review.combat: Bell Reap 22 and Hollow Chime 26 applied damage; final safe-center review retained 100 player HP; recovery counter 270; phase-rehearsed 450 HP defeated with ultimate; reset observed.
review.phase: Distinct form observed via explicitly labelled phase rehearsal; natural threshold crossing not reviewed.
